name: Teamspective
description:
Teamspective is a Leadership Enablement Platform that helps leaders understand their teams through engagement surveys, feedback, and collaboration insights. This app enables Claude to access your Teamspective workspace data, providing personalized insights about:

- Your identity & context: Role, teams, direct reports, and data access permissions
- Engagement results: Survey scores, KPIs (engagement, wellbeing, leadership, DEIB), themes, trends, and AI-interpreted insights with benchmarks
- Feedback summaries: Growth feedback, praise, and performance evaluations you've received or given to direct reports
- Survey comments: Qualitative insights from open-text responses with sentiment analysis

Perfect for preparing 1:1s, understanding team sentiment, identifying areas needing attention, and getting actionable leadership guidance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Teamspective to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Teamspective to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.teamspective.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Teamspective MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teamspective lists 32 MCP tools, including answer_structured_feedback, cancel_calendar_event, create_calendar_event, discussions_save, documents_update_or_create, get_calendar_availability, get_discussion_templates, get_discussions, get_document_templates, get_documents, get_engagement_comments, and get_engagement_results.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Teamspective?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Teamspective in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Teamspective requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Teamspective is developed by Teamspective. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
